# BRouter vendored source

Upstream: https://github.com/abrensch/brouter

Source revision: `4d2639af77ea5ed9c30d3e400764eb6f9e8522da`.

Only the Java sources of core, mapaccess, util, expressions and codec, plus routing profiles, are included. These are the sources used by the existing WatchNav integration. License: MIT; see LICENSE in this directory. No external sibling checkout is required to build WatchNav.
